title: SELF DEFENCE TRAINING AT CSV
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim (RCMM) organised a four-day Self-Defence Training Programme for 60 girl students at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vidyalaya, Dharavi, on 7th, 8th, 9th and 12th October 2026.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim (RCMM) organised a four-day Self-Defence Training Programme for 60
girl students at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vidyalaya, Dharavi, on 7th, 8th, 9th and 12th October 2026.
The programme was coordinated by Mrs. Alka Khedkar, Youth Director, RCMM, with training
conducted by Shri Sushil Shishupal.
The initiative aimed to equip the girls with basic self-defence techniques, enhance their awareness of
personal safety and build the confidence to handle potentially unsafe situations. As a gesture of care
and encouragement, bananas were provided to the students after each training session. The
programme helped promote personal safety, confidence and empowerment among the participating
girls, reflecting RCMM’s continued commitment to youth development and girls’ empowerment.
location: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vidyalaya, Dharavi, Mumbai, Maharashtra
